methods.label: Apply the greatest-common-monomial convention
methods.explanation:
Under the recorded curriculum convention, “the common factor” means the greatest common monomial factor. The coefficient of the common factor is the greatest common divisor of the coefficients of the terms. The greatest common divisor of \(12\) and \(18\) is \(6\).

If any common factor is allowed, \(xy\) and \(2xy\) are both valid, with coefficients \(1\) and \(2\), so the wording alone has no unique answer. Under the recorded convention, the requested coefficient is \(6\).
